policy: Only the sources below may back a value in pipeline/ datasets. Every dataset row must carry source_url. If a value cannot be confirmed from a source here, it is left blank and listed in flagged_pipeline.json. Market odds/spreads/totals have NO official source and are never recorded.

sources.name: NBA.com official standings (2026-27, live)
sources.used_for: Canonical standings table; full reconciliation of the 92 completed games (W-L, home/road, conf, last10, streak, OT).

sources.name: NBA.com official standings (2025-26 final)
sources.used_for: Documented Elo-model prior (initial ratings from final win percentages).

sources.name: NBA.com daily scores pages
sources.used_for: Per-date final scores and NBA game deep links (pattern /games?date=YYYY-MM-DD; game links /game/<slug>-<id>).

sources.name: NBA official 2026-27 playing rules (PDF)
sources.used_for: Game structure facts (period length, OT length, rosters) referenced in strategy docs.

sources.name: NBA official injury report policy page
sources.used_for: Injury-report timing policy referenced in signal documentation.

sources.name: ESPN scoreboards/summaries API (ESPN, official NBA broadcast partner)
sources.used_for: Bulk game results and player box scores when NBA JSON endpoints return 403/timeouts from datacenter clients (recorded in data/manifest.json). Game rows are additionally reconciled line-by-line against SRC-P01; player rows are sample-verified against NBA official box-score pages.
sources.caveat: Partner source, not the league itself. Rows must state this.

sources.name: NBA.com official box score pages
sources.used_for: Sample verification of player-level rows sourced from SRC-P06.

sources.name: GitHub Actions fetch log + manifest
sources.used_for: Provenance: every raw file fetched by scripts/fetch_official.py with URL, status, timestamp in data/manifest.json.

excluded.reason: Third-party aggregator; observed stale vs live NBA.com (page-age 2026-10-31 vs live 2026-11-02) — used only as an early cross-check, never as a source of record.
Unofficial fan site presenting itself as standings.
